page_title: REI 1-1 PSG | Reims v PSG 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Matvey Safonov (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+4' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' The PSG players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
88' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Reda Khadra limps off the pitch to be replaced by Thibault De Smet (Reims).
87' Reda Khadra (Reims) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
84' The ratio of the ball possession is 22:78.
83' The substitution has been made. Nuno Mendes (PSG) has replaced Lucas Beraldo.
83' The game has come to an end for Kang-In Lee. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Senny Mayulu (PSG).
78' That will be all from Oumar Diakite who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Reda Khadra (Reims).
77' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Keito Nakamura will be replaced by Amine Salama (Reims).
77' Substitution. Valentin Atangana Edoa makes his way off the pitch and Teddy Teuma (Reims) comes on as his replacement.
74' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
73' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
71' No foul! Referee Jeremie Pignard points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the PSG players.
70' Substitution. Vitinha did his best and is replaced by Fabian Ruiz (PSG).
70' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the PSG goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
68' 1 - 1 GOAL! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) finds the back of the net from close in from a very acute angle.
67' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Nhoa Sangui (Reims) replaces Yaya-Kader Fofana.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Desire Doue departs the field of play to be replaced by Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
61' 7:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
58' The resulting corner from Junya Ito (Reims) is cleared.
57' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Junya Ito (Reims).
56' Desire Doue (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

55' Bradley Barcola (PSG) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar! The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
55' Desire Doue (PSG) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' The game is interrupted now, Desire Doue (PSG) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' PENALTY APPEAL after Desire Doue (PSG) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
49' Vitinha (PSG) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts the ball.
47' Today's referee Jeremie Pignard rightly decides to book Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) for his harsh tackle.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Kang-In Lee (PSG) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

45+3' Desire Doue (PSG) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is out of play. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
43' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' That's unlucky! Kang-In Lee (PSG) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
40' Desire Doue (PSG) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
38' The shots on goal statistics – 1:2.
37' Willian Pacho (PSG) has tested the patience of referee Jeremie Pignard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
36' Kang-In Lee (PSG) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
35' The corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is hurriedly cleared.
34' Cedric Kipre (Reims) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

31' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jeremie Pignard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
30' Keito Nakamura (Reims) meets a cross inside the box, but Matvey Safonov wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
29' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
28' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
26' The ball is cleared after Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

24' What a chance that is! Desire Doue (PSG) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
22' Keito Nakamura (Reims) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
21' Kang-In Lee (PSG) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Yehvann Diouf.
17' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Randal Kolo Muani (PSG), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
14' Keito Nakamura (Reims) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
13' A dangerous looking corner kick from Sergio Akieme (Reims) is cleared to safety by the defence.

12' Keito Nakamura (Reims) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Now Reims have a corner.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Junya Ito displays great vision and sends a pass to Keito Nakamura (Reims), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
9' Reims seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Junya Ito (Reims) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
4' Kang-In Lee (PSG) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
PSG will kick the game off.
Jeremie Pignard will officiate today.
